session: Qwen made source and generated-build corrections in bounded translation-migration phases. environment.java: Pre-existing JDK 21.0.7.6 at C:/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium/jdk-21.0.7.6-hotspot

environmentWorkaround.description: generated android/build.gradle (git-ignored, non-deliverable): maps CMake build staging dirs for react-native-screens, react-native-worklets, react-native-reanimated, expo-modules-core, react-native-gesture-handler and app to short directories under C:/Users/Gerrit/rn01-cxx/{screens,worklets,reanimated,expo-core,gesture-handler,app}; appends -DCMAKE_OBJECT_PATH_MAX=200 for reanimated/expo-core/gesture-handler and -DCMAKE_OBJECT_PATH_MAX=240 for app
environmentWorkaround.reason: Windows deep-path Ninja failures; actual diagnostic evidence includes android-run.log, reanimated-short-build.log, object-path-200-build.log, app-object-240-build.log and expo-core-short-build.log.
environmentWorkaround.evidenceCopy: migration/evidence/RN01-r2/native-build-workaround.gradle (byte-identical copy; verified by hash at freeze)
environmentWorkaround.reproduction: After Expo prebuild, insert the captured subprojects hook before the React root-project plugin in ignored target android/build.gradle, with dedicated short local staging paths. Then rerun the target Android command under Node24/JDK21/SDK.

finalSoftwareBattery.script: migration/evidence/RN01-r2/final-validation.sh; Qwen-authored, executed sequentially by coordinator after all previous processes ended.
finalSoftwareBattery.history: Earlier interrupted install attempts and the Node v26.3.0 battery are historical; the latter reported the stale Explore-route type error. Current evidence is the final complete block and final acceptance logs.

nativeAcceptance.result: BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m 35s; app-debug.apk installed; development client opened on RN01_API36; Android Bundled; dev.translationtest.rn/.MainActivity resumed. Owned Metro intentionally stopped after capture; development-server termination is not a build failure.
nativeAcceptance.command: npm run android under Node24/JDK21 after the final npm ci; coordinator executed.
nativeAcceptance.logcat: migration/evidence/RN01-r2/final-app-pid.logcat; no fatal/ReactNativeJS errors in recorded scan; startup warnings retained.
